newsitem.title: SPAIN: BoS's Rojo sees domestic corporate debt developing.
newsitem.headline: BoS's Rojo sees domestic corporate debt developing.

text.p: Bank of Spain governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Thursday that the domestic corporate debt market should develop as these instruments are expected to be accepted as collateral in money market operations.

This preparatory move towards a common European monetary policy would be effected with assets which are "of high quality and liquidity" fuelling demand for these instruments, Rojo told an economic conference.
Although the initial volume of private assets would be limited, it would nevertheless be a "very valuable" experience.

He added: "The design of monetary policy could be a relevant factor in generating a financial framework more consistent with the development of private initiative, investment and definitively, economic growth."

The Bank of Spain announced in December that it would start accepting private notes of high quality and liquidity in money market operations in order to adapt to the future European central banking system.
